item.tib: g.yung drung bon gyi bka' brten 'gyur gyi sde tshan sgrig tshul gyi dkar chags nyung 'thus gshen bstan pad mo rgyas byed nyi 'od
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di yang zhi rgyud lde mig dgu skor gyi lung las/ stong gsum 'jig rten gling mchog grangs mang yang / kun las mchog gyur mi lus gtsang ma thob/ gtsang ma mi la dbang ldan grangs mang yang / kun la bka' btsan dbang chen rgyal du skyes/ gtsug lag bu bzhi'i bstan pa grangs mang yang / bstan pa'i mchog gyur g.yung drung bon sgor zhugs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ grub mtha'i rgyal po g.yung drung gi bon rin po che bka' 'gyur brten 'gyur gyi sde tshan bsgrigs tshul tho long tsam bkod pa bstan 'dzin bon spyod rnams kyis mnal slong bstan pa'i me ro spar ba'i rlung g.yab bon gyi pad mo rgyas byed nyi 'od ces bya ba 'di yang / 'phags pa'i rnam rol dge bshes mchog spral rnam gnyis kyis rten 'brel srid na che ba'i gnang rten dang bcas pa'i bka' lung spyi bor phab bzhin rgyal ba mnyam med pa'i gdan sa skyong khul gyi mkhan rabs nyer gnyis pa sgo rigs skam zhig gyi drang srong nyi ri shel zhin zur wer 'bod pas g.yas ru'i ri khrod mkhar sna'i bde gsal gsang phug tu brtsams pa dge bas g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa phyogs brgyar 'phel zhing bstan 'dzin skyes mchog zung gi sku tshe bskal brgyar brtan zhing 'phrin las rab tu rgyas par gyur cig/
